notes.title: Update 0.3
notes.content:
Added audio volumes to the asylum
Fixed a couple of walls in the safehouse
Resized the Stoeger shotgun
Updated the title screen/level select room design
Further optimized Bread Island
Fixed a see-through element of the 1897 shotgun

After a long bout of burnout, and working on the other Woo Studios project, Bread Or Dead will continue. It's a bit jarring coming back to it, as I haven't played in a while, but I'll be sure to make some good changes to come.

notes.title: Update 0.2.1
notes.content:
Hey folks. Just a quick little update to start of the new year to address some issues that had come up. We've been working hard on our other game, BrVR Backrooms VR over the holidays, but now that we're back, we're going to be doing more regular updates.

[b]Added Service Rifle
Rebalanced Stim Pack Sell Prices
Removed an odd scope ring from the m700
Adjusted the logic of handling on some pistols
Optimized some muzzle flashes[/b]

notes.title: Update 0.2.0
notes.content:
Overall, some big improvements to looting in this update. Some long-awaited requests like new stims and openable shelves have been added.

General Improvements

- Added new stim packs - 20%, 40%, and 60%
- Added a new stim pack model
- Fixed P250 Recoil
- Streamlined collision with a couple of pistols
- *hopefully* fixed an issue with lighter flames not appearing


Story Mode (Beta)

- Added Openable Shelves
- Added an affordance to the Bread Island time machine saying it'll send you back in time
- Added a hunger/thirst system to Story Mode, see it on your left watch
- Added a gun dealer to the Russian Apartment map
- Added new looting barrels

Plus some smaller improvements...

notes.title: Patch 0.1.2
notes.content:
General Improvements

- Improved revolver shake interaction
- Improved overall weapon recoil mechanics (Currently, there's a bug with the P350)
- Improved handling logic for Bolt-actions and Double-barrels
- Fixed issues with the Marauder AI
- Added new hit detection for concrete blockers and fridges making them easier to open
- Decreased the height of the table in Level Select
- Various other small improvements
- Made some weapons significantly easier to charge

Arcade Mode

- Adjusted spaceship volume
- Adjusted infinite ammo pistol

Camp Mode

- Made it so that flares can be put out at day and night

Story Mode (Beta)

- Added some tutorial text to the vault 
- Added a check box to bring your pet along on the maps screen
- Added some more beachfront properties to Bread Island
- Filled up several houses in Bread Island with loot boxes
- Added an alligator paperweight to the safehouse (Thanks NotASDF)

Plus various other small improvements...

notes.title: Hotfix 0.1.1
notes.content:
- Fixed some issues with scalability settings
- Fixed an issue with a dirt decal in the gun range
- Overrode some options until they're more fleshed out: All weapons have mag releases, sliding is inactive, and charging handles are easier to grab
- Fixed some positions of items in the Asylum
